urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to capture, one per line, e.g. https://apify.com. https:// is added when missing. Only these URLs are loaded; no links are followed. Each successful screenshot is billed as one event; failed URLs are free.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional alternative to URLs, in Apify's request-list format (e.g. from another actor or a file). Combined with URLs.

format.title: Format
format.description: Image format, or PDF (a vector PDF of the page with backgrounds).

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of just the viewport. For PDF, renders the whole page as one tall page.

device.title: Device
device.description: Viewport preset. Desktop: 1920x1080. Tablet: 820x1180 at 2x (iPad). Mobile: 390x844 at 2x (iPhone), with a mobile user agent and touch.

width.title: Viewport width (px)
width.description: Overrides the device preset's viewport width.

height.title: Viewport height (px)
height.description: Overrides the device preset's viewport height.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: JPEG and WebP quality, 1-100. Lower is smaller.

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: When the page counts as loaded. If it times out, the actor retries once with the next lighter option (Network idle → Load → DOM ready → first response).

delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Wait this long after the page loads, e.g. for animations or late content.

waitForSelector.title: Wait for selector
waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before capturing, e.g. #main. The URL fails if it doesn't appear within the timeout.

selector.title: Capture element
selector.description: Optional CSS selector: capture only the first matching element (e.g. header or .pricing-table) instead of the page. Ignored for PDF.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners
hideCookieBanners.description: Hide common cookie-consent banners (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, Didomi, Quantcast and more) with CSS. Best-effort; nothing is clicked.

scrollToBottom.title: Scroll to bottom
scrollToBottom.description: Scroll through the page before capturing so lazy-loaded images and sections render. Useful with Full page.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per URL (s)
timeoutSecs.description: Max time to load each page (and to wait for selectors).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Pages captured in parallel. 3 fits the default 2 GB memory; raise memory for more.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy, e.g. for sites that block datacenter IPs or to capture a page from another country. Off by default.
